answer.answer: PM JANMAN stands for PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan [E01]. It targets Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) [E01], specifically those residing in the 18 States and Union Territories having a notified PVTG population [E03].
